verdict.rationale: Railway documents its own scaling primitives on the same platform: vertical CPU/RAM scaling, replicas with load balancing, networking and load balancing active from the first deploy, and multi-region placement. That suggests a prototype can grow without switching platforms, but the evidence never explicitly claims continuity to massive scale. missing for 10: explicit documentation that core APIs and primitives stay the same from prototype to massive scale, documented scale limits or large-scale case studies, independent or hands-on corroboration of growth without rearchitecting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on the same core APIs and primitives from prototype through massive scale, without rearchitecting or migrating platforms as usage grows

citations.quote: Scale CPU and RAM or add replicas with load balancing.
Private connections, public endpoints, SSL, and load balancing live from the moment you deploy.
Run your application closer to where your users are.
